snippet.title: mikeyeldey95 for Sega Genesis / Mega Drive - Releases June 24, 2022
snippet.description:
Pre-order cartridges here: https://mikeyeldey.bandcamp.com/

The ROM file will be available for free here: https://mikeyeldey.itch.io/mikeyeldey95

Unlock the potential of your Sega console with mikeyeldey95.

Relive the experience of 90s computing and the early Internet in this all-new game for the Sega Genesis / Mega Drive.

Features:

- Over 20 original mikeyeldey songs
- Desktop user interface and Start Menu application launcher
- 5 Minigames:
‎‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎- 3D Maze – A familiar classic comes to the Sega Genesis.
‎‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎- Ambulance – Arcade traffic weaving game.
‎‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎- FlappyMike – Steer the propeller-beanie through the pipes.
‎‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎- Hacky Sack – How long can you keep it bouncing?
‎‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎- Reflex – Be fast on the buttons as music speeds up.
- 7 Visualizers, including bouncing cards and flying toasters
- Customize your experience with selectable desktop wallpapers and colour palettes
- Interactive Internet browser and email inbox simulator
- ME-DOS Mode, featuring 8-bit PSG chip bonus tracks

The soundtrack will be available on all streaming services. Unlike my first Sega game where I adapted an existing piece of music to the hardware, the music for mikeyeldey95 was composed for the console outright.

#SegaGenesis #MegaDrive #mikeyeldey95
